description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/memes route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-memes-directory.json
rules: Posts must use a recognizable meme format with the joke contained in the media, not only in the title.
Do not post plain text, unedited social-media screenshots, unrelated clips, or other non-meme content.
No hateful, exploitative, graphic, tragedy-focused, or political-agenda memes.
Avoid overused templates, chain posts, flooding, reposts, and other repetitive content.
No interaction bait, vote begging, personal information, watermarks, or self-promotion.
Mark permitted mature content as NSFW; pornography and sexualized content involving minors are forbidden.
